description: What one incremental AgentLaneEvent does to a lane snapshot. Three verbs describe a live run: a block appears or changes (an upsert, so a start and a later completion are the same operation), a block disappears, or a handoff is recorded. The reducer (AgentLanesSnapshot.Apply) applies them to a new value and never edits the snapshot it was given.

members.name: BlockUpserted
members.description: Adds the block, or replaces the block with the same AgentLaneBlock.Id in place (its position in the list is kept).

members.name: BlockRemoved
members.description: Removes the block named by AgentLaneEvent.BlockId; an unknown id is a no-op.

members.name: HandoffAdded
members.description: Records the handoff, unless the same link is already present.
